events.title: The Netherwake release date has been set!
events.summary: After a long time of blood and sweat, we are finally ready to announce the release date of our new horror game Netherwake Chapter One. events.title: Netherwake is participating in Steamfest!
events.summary: We are pleased to announce that Netherwake will be participating in this year's Steamfest 19. oct - 26. oct. Since Netherwake is a story-driven horror game, we have been wondering how we can best showcase our game, while not giving too much away. We have therefore decided that the demo will start from the beginning of the game, and will last for about 15 minutes.
